concepts.name: 骨灰款 · 黑金嵌纹
concepts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the provided MOVERNO sneaker image. Image 1 is the exact shoe edit target. Image 2 is the user's exact approved brand pattern to transfer onto the shoe, NOT an alternate shoe. The user asks to add this exact signature pattern to the lateral upper organically, with fashion-forward restrained dark luxury for young adults.
Preserve the whole original shoe geometry, silhouette, material palette, panel cuts, macro side appliques, toe box perforations, laces and lace crossings, tongue, existing MOVERNO gate logo, collar padding, sole contour, outsole tread, stitched seams, camera angle, shoe location, white studio background, lighting, and contact shadow. Change only the specified lateral panel surfaces. Do NOT redesign the shoe. One shoe only, heel left and toe right, same composition and 1536x1024 output.
The added artwork must faithfully reproduce Image 2: continuous staggered columns of long vertically oriented paired curved chambers, very narrow black central slits, thin aged-brass outline on the outside boundaries only, matte black and weathered charcoal chamber faces, tiny restrained deep-burgundy connector nodes. Keep the distinctive long proportions, staggered repeats and smooth curves recognizable. Actual source-pattern geometry, not generic diamonds, leaves, chainmail, monogram letters or new symbols. Render as finely printed / shallow embossed leather or woven inset with subtle material relief. Linework appears integrated into material and lit by the same light as the shoe; artwork conforms to the local perspective, slight curvature and seam boundaries. Aged-gold lines should be thin and muted; red nodes tiny, no bright colors, no bulky metallic hardware. No gold wash over whole shoe, no pattern pasted on background, no wordmarks, numbers, watermark or captions.
For THIS BONE-AND-BLACK SHOE: retain both existing large black side applique shapes, their exact silhouettes and narrow ivory slit openings. Transfer the approved black/charcoal/aged-brass/burgundy pattern INSIDE the face of those existing two dark appliques only. Pattern flows in continuous registration across the two appliques as if both were cut from the same patterned leather sheet, while remaining cropped by their existing edges and interrupted by the ivory base leather and central slits. Use medium-small repeats with 2 to 3 narrow repeat columns across each applique and at least one full elongated chamber visible, so the signature is readable at product-photo scale. Keep the black perimeter seam allowance plain and the black stitching legible. Bone base leather, black suede toe surround and heel, ivory tongue logo, laces and every part of the sole stay exactly as in Image 1. The visual goal is rich dark patterned inlays framed by generous clean ivory leather, preserving the original bold low skate design.
